ios.desc:
Don't let your friends reading suggestions get lost in text conversations.

How it works:

1. Copy your link and send it to friends or add it to your social media pages. 
2. Friends can use think link to send things you might enjoy reading.
3. Delete them when you're done.

show_hn.title: Show HN: FYP – a link based reading app using notifications

quotes.text:
I just released (hours ago) a new reading app called FYP. It provides you with a shareable link your peers can use to share links with you. It's built almost completely on Google's Cloud Messaging platform, so links shared with you are sent directly from a go server to your phones local storage.

Motivation for FYP came from me receiving lot's of links to videos/articles/etc and either 1) losing them in the noise of my day-to-day communication, or 2) feeling the odd pressure of needing to respond back to the person who sent it.
